claim: An Indonesian marketing agency publishes monthly creator income tiers of Rp 500,000-3,000,000 (0-10K followers), Rp 3,000,000-15,000,000 (10K-100K), and Rp 15,000,000-50,000,000+ (100K+), while explicitly labelling them estimates with no stated data source.
stance_target: The position that widely circulated Indonesian creator-income figures are agency assertions rather than measurements, and that the apparent availability of SEA income data is an artefact of unsourced content marketing
scope_conditions: Indonesia; 2026; Rocket Digital Agency SEO article; self-declared estimates; no sample, no survey, no methodology; article illustration credited to ChatGPT
quoted_support: Perlu diingat, angka tersebut merupakan estimasi. Gaji seorang content creator bisa beragam tergantung dari kualitas kontennya dan bidang yang dipilih.

claim: The same agency states that Indonesian creators typically take from several months to more than a year to begin earning, with no supporting data.
stance_target: The position that time from starting to first meaningful income in Southeast Asia is consistently described as months-to-a-year across independent low-authority sources, but has never been measured
scope_conditions: Indonesia; 2026; FAQ answer in an agency SEO article; no data source
quoted_support: Berapa lama content creator bisa mulai menghasilkan? Biasanya membutuhkan waktu beberapa bulan hingga lebih dari satu tahun, tergantung pada proses yang dilalui.
numbers: several months to more than one year

claim: Impatience with the delay before results is named as a reason Indonesian beginner creators stop, listed among common beginner mistakes rather than derived from any exit survey.
stance_target: The position that no documented, survey-based reasons for quitting exist for Southeast Asian creators, leaving only unsourced practitioner and agency assertions that the unpaid build period drives exit
scope_conditions: Indonesia; 2026; single unsourced sentence within a list of beginner errors; not an exit survey
quoted_support: Ingin Cepat Mendapatkan Hasil. Banyak yang berhenti karena belum melihat hasil dalam waktu singkat.
